sections.title: Describe this crossing
sections.description: Simple questions about what is physically present here.

questions.text: Can people cross the road here?

options.text: No, it is not possible or very unsafe to cross here
People cross here, but there is no marked or protected crossing space
Yes, there are zebra stripes, but no traffic light
Yes, there are zebra stripes and a traffic light
Yes, there is an underpass or tunnel
Yes, there is a bridge or overpass

questions.text: Is there a sign or road marking that allows people to cross here by bicycle?

options.text: Yes
No
I do not know

questions.text: If bicycles are allowed, is the bicycle crossing space separate from the pedestrian space?

options.text: Yes, bicycles have a separate marked space
No, bicycles and pedestrians use the same space
I do not know

questions.text: How many car lanes do people cross here?

options.text: 1 lane
2 lanes
3 lanes
More than 3 lanes

questions.text: Is the crossing clearly visible?

options.text: There is no vertical sign
There are no visible crossing markings on the road
The crossing markings are faded or worn out
Trees, poles, signs, or other vertical elements hide the crossing sign
Vehicles often stop on the crossing
The crossing is clearly visible

questions.text: What helps people cross safely here?

options.text: There is good lighting
The crossing is raised above the road level
There is a small waiting space in the middle of the road, but it is not protected
There is a protected island in the middle of the road
There is a pedestrian traffic light with complete stop for traffic
None of these

questions.text: Do people need to step outside the crossing to see approaching traffic?

options.text: No, people can see traffic from the crossing space
Yes, because illegally parked vehicles block the view
Yes, because parked vehicles block the view
Yes, because trees or plants block the view
Yes, because the road bends or curves
Yes, because bins or containers block the view
Yes, because signs, poles, boxes, or street furniture block the view
Yes, for another reason

questions.text: Is there enough safe space to wait before crossing?

options.text: No, there is no safe place to wait
There is a place to wait, but it is too small
Yes, there is enough safe space to wait
No waiting space is needed here

questions.text: Can people with different needs use this crossing easily?

options.text: People in wheelchairs can use it
People with strollers can use it
There is tactile paving for blind or visually impaired people
There is a sound signal for blind or visually impaired people
None of these

questions.text: Is the bridge or overpass covered?

options.text: No, it is not covered
Yes, it has a roof or canopy
Yes, it is enclosed by walls or panels
Yes, it has glass or transparent panels
Other

questions.text: What is the underpass or tunnel like?

options.text: It is well lit
The walking surface is clean and without litter
The walls and ceiling are in good condition
There is no standing water
There is an elevator and/or escalator
None of these

sections.title: Your experience here
sections.description: Simple questions about how people use this crossing.

questions.text: How often do you use this crossing?

options.text: This is my first time
Less than once a month
A few times a month
A few times a week
Almost every day

questions.text: When people wait to cross, how often do drivers stop?

options.text: Drivers rarely stop; people usually wait for a gap in traffic
Some drivers stop, but others continue driving
Most drivers stop when they see someone waiting
Drivers almost always stop, so people can cross quickly

questions.text: At the traffic light, how long do people usually wait before they can cross?

options.text: They can usually cross almost immediately, less than 10 seconds
A short wait, about 10–30 seconds
A medium wait, about 30–60 seconds
A long wait, about 1–2 minutes
A very long wait, more than 2 minutes

questions.text: Is this waiting time acceptable?

options.text: Yes
No

questions.text: How safe do you feel in this underpass or tunnel?

options.text: Very safe
Mostly safe
Neither safe nor unsafe
Somewhat unsafe
Very unsafe

questions.text: How safe do you feel on this bridge or overpass?

options.text: Very safe
Mostly safe
Neither safe nor unsafe
Somewhat unsafe
Very unsafe

sections.title: Improve this crossing
sections.description: A short diagnosis of whether this crossing needs improvement.

questions.text: Would you like a marked crossing to be added here?

options.text: Yes
No

questions.text: Overall, what is the main situation here?

options.text: It works well as it is
It is designed well, but people use it badly or incorrectly
It is damaged, dirty, or poorly maintained
It is not suitable for the number or type of people using it
It works, but it could be improved

questions.text: How important is it to improve this crossing?

options.text: Not important
Slightly important
Moderately important
Important
Very important

it.#Simple questions about what is physical: Domande semplici su ciò che è presente qui.
it.#Can people cross the road here?: Le persone possono attraversare la strada qui?
it.#No, it is not possible or very unsafe t: No, non è possibile o è molto pericoloso attraversare qui
it.#People cross here, but there is no mark: Le persone attraversano qui, ma non c’è uno spazio segnalato o protetto
it.#Yes, there are zebra stripes, but no tr: Sì, ci sono le strisce pedonali, ma non c’è il semaforo
it.#Yes, there are zebra stripes and a traf: Sì, ci sono le strisce pedonali e il semaforo
it.#Yes, there is a bridge or overpass: Sì, c’è un ponte o sovrappasso
it.#Is there a sign or road marking that al: C’è un cartello o una segnaletica che permette di attraversare qui in bicicletta?
it.#If bicycles are allowed, is the bicycle: Se le biciclette sono autorizzate, lo spazio per attraversare in bici è separato da quello dei pedoni?
it.#Yes, bicycles have a separate marked sp: Sì, le biciclette hanno uno spazio segnalato separato
it.#No, bicycles and pedestrians use the sa: No, biciclette e pedoni usano lo stesso spazio
it.#How many car lanes do people cross here: Quante corsie per auto si attraversano qui?
it.#Can people clearly see that this is a c: Si capisce chiaramente che qui c’è un attraversamento?
it.#No crossing markings are visible: Non si vede nessuna segnaletica di attraversamento
it.#The crossing markings are faded or worn: Le strisce o i segnali sono sbiaditi o consumati
it.#The crossing is often hidden by parked: L’attraversamento è spesso nascosto da veicoli parcheggiati o altri ostacoli temporanei
it.#Vehicles often stop on the crossing: I veicoli spesso si fermano sopra l’attraversamento
it.#Do people need to step outside the cros: Le persone devono uscire dall’attraversamento per vedere il traffico in arrivo?
it.#No, people can see traffic from the cro: No, le persone riescono a vedere il traffico restando nello spazio dell’attraversamento
it.#Yes, because illegally parked vehicles: Sì, perché veicoli parcheggiati illegalmente bloccano la visuale
it.#Yes, because parked vehicles block the: Sì, perché veicoli parcheggiati bloccano la visuale
it.#Yes, because trees or plants block the: Sì, perché alberi o piante bloccano la visuale
it.#Yes, because bins or containers block t: Sì, perché cassonetti o contenitori bloccano la visuale
it.#Yes, because signs, poles, boxes, or st: Sì, perché cartelli, pali, centraline o arredi urbani bloccano la visuale
it.#What helps people cross safely here?: Cosa aiuta le persone ad attraversare in sicurezza qui?
it.#The crossing is raised above the road l: L’attraversamento è rialzato rispetto alla strada
it.#There is a small waiting space in the m: C’è un piccolo spazio di attesa al centro della strada, ma non è protetto
it.#There is a protected island in the midd: C’è un’isola protetta al centro della strada
it.#There is a pedestrian traffic light wit: C’è un semaforo pedonale che ferma completamente il traffico
it.#Is there enough safe space to wait befo: C’è abbastanza spazio sicuro per aspettare prima di attraversare?
it.#No, there is no safe place to wait: No, non c’è un posto sicuro dove aspettare
it.#There is a place to wait, but it is too: C’è uno spazio per aspettare, ma è troppo piccolo
it.#Yes, there is enough safe space to wait: Sì, c’è abbastanza spazio sicuro per aspettare
it.#No waiting space is needed here: Qui non serve uno spazio di attesa
it.#Can people with different needs use thi: Le persone con esigenze diverse possono usare facilmente questo attraversamento?
it.#People in wheelchairs can use it: Le persone in sedia a rotelle possono usarlo
it.#People with strollers can use it: Le persone con passeggini possono usarlo
it.#There is tactile paving for blind or vi: C’è un percorso tattile per persone cieche o ipovedenti
it.#There is a sound signal for blind or vi: C’è un segnale sonoro per persone cieche o ipovedenti
it.#Is the bridge or overpass covered?: Il ponte o sovrappasso è coperto?
it.#Yes, it has a roof or canopy: Sì, ha una tettoia o copertura
it.#Yes, it is enclosed by walls or panels: Sì, è chiuso da pareti o pannelli
it.#Yes, it has glass or transparent panels: Sì, ha vetri o pannelli trasparenti
it.#The walking surface is clean and withou: La superficie è pulita e senza rifiuti
it.#The walls and ceiling are in good condi: Pareti e soffitto sono in buone condizioni
it.#There is an elevator and/or escalator: C’è un ascensore e/o una scala mobile
it.#Simple questions about how people use t: Domande semplici su come viene usato questo attraversamento.
it.#Less than once a month: Meno di una volta al mese
it.#When people wait to cross, how often do: Quando le persone aspettano di attraversare, quanto spesso i conducenti si fermano?
it.#Drivers rarely stop; people usually wai: I conducenti si fermano raramente; di solito le persone aspettano un varco nel traffico
it.#Some drivers stop, but others continue: Alcuni conducenti si fermano, altri proseguono
it.#Most drivers stop when they see someone: La maggior parte dei conducenti si ferma quando vede qualcuno in attesa
it.#Drivers almost always stop, so people c: I conducenti si fermano quasi sempre, quindi le persone attraversano rapidamente
it.#At the traffic light, how long do peopl: Al semaforo, quanto tempo aspettano di solito le persone prima di attraversare?
it.#They can usually cross almost immediate: Di solito possono attraversare quasi subito, meno di 10 secondi
it.#A very long wait, more than 2 minutes: Un’attesa molto lunga, più di 2 minuti
it.#Is this waiting time acceptable?: Questo tempo di attesa è accettabile?
it.#How safe do you feel in this underpass: Quanto ti senti al sicuro in questo sottopasso?
it.#How safe do you feel on this bridge or: Quanto ti senti al sicuro su questo ponte o sovrappasso?
it.#A short diagnosis of whether this cross: Una valutazione sintetica per capire se questo attraversamento va migliorato.
it.#Would you like a marked crossing to be: Vorresti che qui fosse aggiunto un attraversamento segnalato?
it.#Overall, what is the main situation her: Nel complesso, qual è la situazione principale qui?
it.#It is designed well, but people use it: È progettato bene, ma le persone lo usano male o in modo scorretto
it.#It is damaged, dirty, or poorly maintai: È danneggiato, sporco o mantenuto male
it.#It is not suitable for the number or ty: Non è adatto al numero o al tipo di persone che lo usano
it.#How important is it to improve this cro: Quanto è importante migliorare questo attraversamento?
